title: ZE17 11 — wejscie na schody
description: Fragment 11/18 jednego ciągłego ujęcia. First f0481 → Last f0529. 3 s, 24 fps, normalne tempo 1×; bez przyspieszania. Pozycja w sekwencji: 30–33 s. Last jest identyczny plikowo z First następnego shota. Tło bez pióra; pióro będzie warstwą z Blendera. Wybrane obrazy zachowują różnice odnotowane w _system/clean-plates-v001/pair-audit-v003.json; przygotowanie shota nie oznacza zatwierdzenia wszystkich detali.

prompts.image:
Generate a NEW photographic 16:9 film background at Poznan railway station, blue dusk. Image1 determines exact camera and structural layout; image2 supplies stone and terrazzo textures ONLY, image3 real Polish railway textures. Do not adopt the viewpoints of images2/3. Railway fills left half, stairs on right. Continuous solid ballast supports the rails and sleepers, no void or corridor beneath or next to the track.
MOST IMPORTANT GEOMETRY: The diagonal stairwell divider wall starts at (50% width,0% height) and ENDS at (74% width,67% height). It has a clear vertical END FACE there. Below that endpoint the bottom-right quadrant is a BROAD FLAT LANDING, not more descending stairs and not an extended wall. The wall must NOT reach the bottom edge. The top nosing of the descending stair flight lies across the right region around y40–48%; stairs descend AWAY from this foreground landing into the upper-right of image1. Foreground landing occupies approximately x73–100%, y68–100%. Copy exactly the short rail at x66–79%, y42–49% and its support near x77%, y65%. The wall end and the landing are the composition's key anchors. Preserve them instead of inventing a long picturesque staircase extending to the bottom. Real stone wall cladding, grey terrazzo landing and steps, thin metal handrails. Cropped black amber departure board at top-right, subdued warm practical light inside. No people or feather, no extra passageway, no added architecture. Photographic natural surfaces, not primitive 3D render.
Railway is HORIZONTAL LEVEL ground seen at a steep DOWNWARD camera angle. Tracks simply continue OUT of the TOP EDGE. No visible skyline, no sky, no horizon, no rise or hill, no elevated railway embankment, no track ramp. All upper background is the cropped near station ground and passage walls exactly like image1. Keep the divider wall end at x74%,y67% and flat landing at bottom-right. Do not make the stairs face a blind wall; corridor continues sideways beyond camera visibility.
prompts.endFrameDescription: Wspólna klatka graniczna f0529; dokładne zakończenie segmentu i początek następnego.
prompts.animation: 0-3s: Curve right over the open stair entrance and align with the descending flight. The rails leave screen left while the staircase centers and the distant standing listener becomes visible through the opening. Stay above the open stairs, outside walls. The listener remains planted, arms down, with subtle breathing only. No walking or head turn. Camera motion continues through both boundaries, reaching the supplied End Frame at 3s. Keep architecture rigid and dusk exposure stable. No feather, cuts, dissolves, morphs or new people. @Image1: railway materials only, not daylight or camera layout. @Image2: station surface materials only, not its viewpoint or signs.
